question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval prompts bind apply, reject, and quarantine to the proposal version shown to the operator, failing closed after any revision?
rationale: This is a user-visible lifecycle contract: it changes how an existing pending approval behaves after a proposal revision, and neither tests nor static review can choose the desired operator policy.

options.title: Adopt exact-snapshot approval binding
options.body: Keep the version-bound pending approval behavior so an operator decision can never act on content changed after the displayed review.

options.title: Ship preview without lifecycle binding
options.body: Retain read-only previews but preserve the prior pending-approval lifecycle semantics until a separate approval-contract decision is made.

recommendation.title: Adopt exact-snapshot approval binding
recommendation.body: Keep the version-bound pending approval behavior so an operator decision can never act on content changed after the displayed review.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes the product review here, while available evidence does not identify a stronger current-main code owner.
